newsitem.title: USA: First Tennessee files for $1 million shelf.
newsitem.headline: First Tennessee files for $1 million shelf.

text.p: First Tennessee National Corp said Monday four of its business trusts filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 million in preferred securities.

The four business trusts known as First Tennessee Capital I, First Tennessee Capital II, First Tennessee Capital III and First Tennessee Capital IV will use proceeds from the sale to buy junior subordinated debentures of the parent company.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the Memphis-based banking company said the offering will be made through Goldman, Sachs & Co.

The bank said funds received from the trusts will be used for general corporate purposes including stock repurchases, the reduction of indebtedness, investments in or extensions of credit to existing and future subsidiaries.
The filing was made in a nominal amount. In practice, companies often amend registration statements later on to reflect a bigger amount of securities to be sold.
